name: More Unstable Magic
summary: The Earthen Ring seeks more motes of unstable magic for study. Their concern is that reality itself is fraying.

sections.title: The Earthen Ring's Concern
sections.body: The Earthen Ring needs raw material to study as reality seems to fray. You are asked to bring any additional motes of unstable magic you encounter in your travels.

faq.q: What does the Earthen Ring need?
faq.answer: The Earthen Ring needs more motes of unstable magic as raw material for study.

faq.q: Why are they gathering unstable magic?
faq.answer: The Earthen Ring wants the motes for study because reality seems to be fraying.
The motes of unstable magic are raw material for the Earthen Ring's study.

attribution: In-game quest text: More Unstable Magic
